scenes.text: The probe had been silent for nineteen years.
Then, at 3:14 in the morning, it answered.
One word. Repeating. From a place no one had mapped.

The probe was launched from Earth.
It had never been anywhere else.
Follow Deep Space Logs for the next entry.
